example.en: She pressed on two little hands.
The little clay person's face turned pink.

simp.text: 女娲给小人捏了两条又粗又壮的腿。

trad.text: 女媧給小人捏了兩條又粗又壯的腿。
trad.bpmf: 女媧給小人捏了兩條又粗又壯的腿。

example.en: So Nuwa pinched two thick, sturdy legs for the little person.
Its eyes blinked.

simp.text: 太阳已经升得高高的了。

trad.text: 太陽已經升得高高的了。
trad.bpmf: 太陽已經升得󠇡高高的了。

example.en: The sun had already climbed high.
In the sky there were the sun and the moon.
Nuwa gazed at a sky full of stars.
The water wound this way and that, flowing across the earth.
The river water was clear.

simp.text: 她靠在河边的大石头上。

trad.text: 她靠在河邊的大石頭上。
trad.bpmf: 她靠在河邊的大石頭上。

example.en: She leaned against a big stone by the riverbank.
So Nuwa picked up the yellow clay again.

simp.text: 她捏成一个小小的身体。

trad.text: 她捏成一個小小的身體。
trad.bpmf: 她捏成一󠇡個󠇡小小的身體。

example.en: She pinched out a tiny little body.
Some of them became men.
Men and women gathered around Nuwa.

simp.text: 她给这些小小的生命取了一个名字。

trad.text: 她給這些小小的生命取了一個名字。
trad.bpmf: 她給這些小小的生命取了一󠇡個󠇡名字󠇡。

example.en: She gave these tiny lives a name.

vocab.en: Nuwa: the goddess with a human head and a serpent's body who shaped the first people out of yellow clay

example.en: Her name was Nuwa.

vocab.en: Fuxi: Nuwa's older brother, a god of the same shape, who roamed the new world with her

example.en: Her older brother was called Fuxi.

vocab.en: the Yellow River: the great river of northern China, where Nuwa scooped up the clay

example.en: Nuwa came to the bank of the Yellow River.

simp.text: 有一位女神慢慢走在大地上。

trad.text: 有一位女神慢慢走在大地上。
trad.bpmf: 有一󠇡位女神慢慢走在大地上。

example.en: A goddess was walking slowly across the earth.

simp.text: 女娲最喜欢大地上活泼的小动物。

trad.text: 女媧最喜歡大地上活潑的小動物。
trad.bpmf: 女媧最喜歡大地上活潑的小動物。

example.en: What Nuwa loved most were the lively little animals of the earth.

simp.text: 觉得很孤单，希望有人能和她说话。

trad.text: 覺得很孤單，希望有人能和她說話。
trad.bpmf: 覺得󠇡很孤單，希望有人能和她說話。

example.en: She felt very lonely, and wished someone could talk with her.

simp.text: 一张温柔的脸，一双灵巧的手。

trad.text: 一張溫柔的臉，一雙靈巧的手。
trad.bpmf: 一󠇢張溫柔的臉，一󠇢雙靈巧的手。

example.en: A gentle face, and a pair of nimble hands.
She also had a pair of nimble hands.
A serpent's body is very convenient.
Something magical happened!

simp.text: 新的生命还是会不断出生。

trad.text: 新的生命還是會不斷出生。
trad.bpmf: 新的生命還是會不󠇡斷出生。

example.en: New lives would still keep on being born.
The earth grew lively and bustling again.

vocab.en: to use your head, to think something through

simp.text: 会走路、会说话、会动脑筋。

trad.text: 會走路、會說話、會動腦筋。
trad.bpmf: 會走路、會說話、會動腦筋。

example.en: It could walk, it could talk, it could use its head.

vocab.en: to respect, to hold in honour

simp.text: 从那天起，人们都很尊敬女娲。

trad.text: 從那天起，人們都很尊敬女媧。
trad.bpmf: 從那天起，人們都很尊敬女媧。

example.en: From that day on, people respected Nuwa deeply.
Her heart was full of contentment.
